bio: Hello everyone, my name is Yash Kshirsagar and I'm a passionate Software Developer with a specialization in building modern, scalable web applications and intelligent AI-powered solutions. I love working with React, Node.js, modern JavaScript, AI integrations, and building robust end-to-end software.

Driven by curiosity and a desire for excellence, I constantly strive to learn new technologies, integrate AI capabilities, and improve my craft. My goal is to build software systems that are reliable, performant, and deliver impactful user experiences.

I have experience in a wide range of technologies across full-stack development, modern frameworks, AI APIs, databases, and cloud tools. I'm always excited to take on new challenges and contribute to innovative projects.
